decisions.rationale: The draft is useful as an internal proof that the writing harness can move from source packet to critique repair. Loop 38 added a public-facing before/after writing artifact, Loop 39 added a real revision trace from this draft's own opening, Loop 40 added a cold-reader red-pen test, Loop 41 added a one-minute paragraph autopsy form, Loop 42 added a private HTML review artifact, Loop 43 added rendered screenshot proof for that private review surface, Loop 44 used that artifact for an editorial-system critique, Loop 45 revised the private draft against that critique, Loop 46 tightened the revised draft by removing a repeated weak-paragraph block and replacing stale prior-loop phrasing, Loop 47 judged the current draft ready for human promotion review while still not public-ready, Loop 49 added a reference-blogger readiness gate, Loop 50 added a review-desk protocol that turns vague style review into source, decision, artifact, and reject-condition fields, Loop 51 surfaced that protocol in the private HTML review artifact, Loop 52 created a current-hash human promotion review packet, Loop 53 made the remaining real-evidence blocker explicit, Loop 54 attached hash-bound real failed-draft evidence from the Loop 44 rendered-artifact critique and Loop 45 repair, Loop 67 reduced packet-report scaffolding so the draft reads more like a cold-reader article, and Loop 68 decoupled reference-blogger verification roles from literal packet headings so the private draft can use reader-facing article headings without weakening the gates. The draft now opens with a reader-recognizable bad AI paragraph, asks a sharper reader question, maps AutoAgent into a writing harness without making the source thread feel like homework, gives the reader a concrete review protocol for their own drafts, and has a real failure/repair trace from its own history. It still needs human critique, public rendered candidate proof, public image contract promotion, and final hash approval before this can become a public approval candidate.

decisions.rationale: Loop 128 ran a real user-provided source through the article-production harness from source packet to private draft, reference critique, rendered review artifact, publisher queue item, and human promotion review packet. The AI critic panel then found that the workflow chain exists and publication remains blocked, but the draft should be revised before human review because the prior article body mixed writer, critic, QA, publisher, and approval voices. The draft now has a clearer reader-facing field-note voice and a defensible operating claim: self-improving agent loops need a judge outside the loop because a benchmark can miss source trust, evidence fit, rendered output, and human reader risk. It remains private because the source is transcript-note based, the public image contract does not exist, the rendered candidate route does not exist, a fresh voice-aware reference critique has not accepted the revision, and no human reviewer has accepted the final markdown hash.
